caption: Back exercises at home no equipment required: every home already has a row station, it is called a doorframe. Four rungs, from a lean row to a single arm row. Save the ladder.

voiceover.text: Home workouts train half your body. Here is the missing half.
There is nothing to pull at home, except every room has a doorframe.
Rung one. Doorframe lean rows. Ten reps. Hold the frame, lean back, pull your chest to your hands.
Rung two. Doorframe rows. Eight reps. Feet closer to the frame, deeper lean, harder pull.
Rung three. Deep doorframe rows. Eight reps. Sit further back, full range, slow return.
Rung four. Single arm doorframe rows. Six reps each side. The top of the ladder.
Grip low, heels planted, and move slow in both directions.
Your back works harder for you than anything else you train. Which doorframe will you use? Comment the room.

overlays.text: The missing half of home strength.
Every room has a row station.
